title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 5: The Price of the Door
description: At the closed western station, the part home needs is still protecting something. Carry your evidence forward, inspect before acting, and choose who bears the cost.
notice: An original Star Wars fan adventure. Play Jonathan in short Mandarin with pinyin, English help and recorded audio. Confirm your earlier outcome first; it shapes the equipment and options in this attempt. Four story choices, lasting material consequences, no value scores. Reading has no time limit.

context.title: Episode V · The Price of the Door
paragraphs: The storm is over, but the communities still live with their agreement, their losses, and the water they have left. Jonathan and An have isolated a damaged pipe. The evidence they carried home now points toward a western station that was supposed to be closed.

Somewhere inside may be the part their homes need. Yet a thing that looks abandoned may still be doing a vital job. Jonathan has learned to listen when An says stop. Now he must decide what bringing something home is worth—and who should pay.

teaser.prompt: Animate this exact shonen anime reference, preserving adult Jonathan and An, faces, clothes and station layout. One continuous six-second shot, subtle slow push toward Jonathan. Jonathan keeps his hand hovering beside the brass ring and looks at An with grave resolve. Jonathan alone says in clear natural English exactly once: "If we take this, who pays the price?" Speak from second 0.3 through second 4.5, then close his mouth. An keeps her hands on the lever, listens with tense eyes and does not speak. No additional words, repetition, fillers, humming, narration, lyrics or other voices. Quiet metal strain and distant water under the speech. Do not remove the ring, move the door, resolve the choice, add characters or text. Subtle breathing and light dust only. Native English dialogue must be clearly audible.
